fields.topology_type: Point-to-point only — 1 TFP410 transmitter ↔ 1 DVI/HDMI receiver per cable. No bus, no daisy chain, no multi-drop. Sideband DDC (I2C) is bidirectional half-duplex; HPD is sink → source; RSEN is source-side passive sense.

supported_topologies.name: Single TFP410 ↔ single DVI/HDMI receiver
supported_topologies.description: Canonical link via Type-A (HDMI) or Type-D (DVI-D) cable; up to ~ 5 m distance at 165 MHz pixel rate before signal degradation.

supported_topologies.name: TFP410 + active equalizer / repeater + receiver
supported_topologies.description: For runs > 5 m, an external DVI/HDMI equalizer (e.g. TI TMDS141) can extend reach; the link itself remains point-to-point.

supported_topologies.name: TFP410 + HDMI splitter / matrix (system-level)
supported_topologies.description: An external HDMI matrix routes one source to multiple sinks, but each leg of the matrix is still a point-to-point TMDS link.

master_slave_role_summary.description: TMDS transmitter; encodes per-pixel R/G/B + sync + CTL into 4 differential pairs; drives current-mode outputs.
TMDS receiver; recovers TXC clock, decodes 10b → 8b per channel, reconstructs pixels; serves EDID over DDC; drives HPD HIGH when present.
Configures TFP410 register file at base 0b0111_A3A2A1 (when ISEL=1); also reads receiver EDID at 0xA0 via the same SCL/SDA wires (DDC bridge).
NOT inside TFP410 — separate device that authenticates with receiver over DDC at 0x74/0x75 and applies cipher scrambling on the parallel pixel input before TFP410.

fields.interconnect_role: TMDS link is a flat point-to-point pair (3 data + 1 clock differential). No routing or addressing on the TMDS wires themselves. Sideband DDC (I2C) provides a configuration + EDID + HDCP channel. HPD provides receiver-presence signaling. RSEN provides source-side passive sense.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_pixel: TX0/TX1/TX2 transmit B/G/R simultaneously, one pixel per IDCK period.
ordering_guarantees.across_pixels: Pixels stream in scan-line order, gated by DE (active video) vs blanking.
ordering_guarantees.within_a_frame: Lines top-to-bottom; within each line, pixels left-to-right; VSYNC + HSYNC delimit frame and line boundaries.
ordering_guarantees.across_channels: No inter-channel correlation in the encoder — each channel maintains its own running disparity; alignment relies on TXC clock.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable for TMDS streaming. TFP410's I2C register file is an addressable peripheral region (sub-addresses 0x00 to 0xFF) with byte read/write only — see L4 register map.

device_classification.DVI_HDMI_receiver: TFP401 (TI receiver counterpart) or any DVI/HDMI sink.
device_classification.display_panel: LCD / OLED / plasma / projector panel timing controller behind the receiver.
device_classification.graphics_controller: PC / SoC / GPU providing pixel stream + IDCK.
device_classification.DVI_HDMI_repeater: Optional external equalizer / re-driver (e.g. TMDS141) for cable extension.
device_classification.HDMI_audio_packetizer: Separate HDMI controller chip (NOT TFP410) that emits audio data islands in vertical blanking.
